title: Austin Holds Closed-Door Special Session
summary:
*   Austin City officials convened a special meeting on February 1, 1978.
*   The entire public session immediately transitioned into a closed, executive meeting.
*   This private discussion was legally authorized under specific Texas statutes for confidential matters.
*   Any final actions or policy decisions made during the closed session would be publicly announced at a later time.
transcript:
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS.
MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL
CITY OF AUSTIN, TEXAS
Special Meeting
February 01, 1978
4:00 Ρ.Μ.
Council Chambers
301 West Second Street
The meeting was called to order with Mayor McClellan presiding. Roll Call: Present:
Councilmembers Cooke, Goodman, Mullen, Mayor Pro Tem Trevino, Mayor McClellan
Absent:
Councilmembers Himmelblau, Snell
Mayor McClellan called the Meeting of the Council to order at 4:00 P.M. and announced that
the Council will convene in a closed or executive session authorized by Section 2,
Paragraphs (e), (f) and (g) of Article 6252-17, Texas Revised Civil Statutes Annotated;
and after such closed or executive session any final action, decision or vote with regard
to any matter considered in the closed or executive session will be made in open session,
should such action, decision or vote be necessary.
